CREATE TRIGGER r12_object_invalidation AFTER UPDATE ON stored_objects
        WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.gym_id IS NOT OLD.gym_id OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind OR NEW.key IS NOT OLD.key OR NEW.content_type IS NOT OLD.content_type OR NEW.byte_size IS NOT OLD.byte_size OR NEW.sha256 IS NOT OLD.sha256 OR NEW.storage_backend IS NOT OLD.storage_backend OR NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status
        BEGIN UPDATE client_plan_publications SET status='withdrawn',publication_version=publication_version+1,withdrawn_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') WHERE gym_id=OLD.gym_id AND source_object_id=OLD.id AND status='published'; END

CREATE TRIGGER r12_plan_invalidation AFTER UPDATE ON planes_generados
        WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.gym_id IS NOT OLD.gym_id OR NEW.id_cliente IS NOT OLD.id_cliente OR NEW.fecha_generacion IS NOT OLD.fecha_generacion OR NEW.tmb IS NOT OLD.tmb OR NEW.get_total IS NOT OLD.get_total OR NEW.kcal_objetivo IS NOT OLD.kcal_objetivo OR NEW.kcal_real IS NOT OLD.kcal_real OR NEW.proteina_g IS NOT OLD.proteina_g OR NEW.carbs_g IS NOT OLD.carbs_g OR NEW.grasa_g IS NOT OLD.grasa_g OR NEW.objetivo IS NOT OLD.objetivo OR NEW.nivel_actividad IS NOT OLD.nivel_actividad OR NEW.ruta_pdf IS NOT OLD.ruta_pdf OR NEW.pdf_object_id IS NOT OLD.pdf_object_id OR NEW.plan_json IS NOT OLD.plan_json OR NEW.deleted_at IS NOT OLD.deleted_at OR NEW.peso_en_momento IS NOT OLD.peso_en_momento OR NEW.grasa_en_momento IS NOT OLD.grasa_en_momento OR NEW.desviacion_maxima_pct IS NOT OLD.desviacion_maxima_pct OR NEW.plantilla_tipo IS NOT OLD.plantilla_tipo OR NEW.tipo_plan IS NOT OLD.tipo_plan
        BEGIN UPDATE client_plan_publications SET status='withdrawn',publication_version=publication_version+1,withdrawn_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') WHERE gym_id=OLD.gym_id AND source_plan_id=OLD.id AND status='published'; END
CREATE TRIGGER r12_publication_delete BEFORE DELETE ON client_plan_publications BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R12 publication removal requires reviewed workflow'); END

CREATE TRIGGER r12_publication_update BEFORE UPDATE ON client_plan_publications
        BEGIN
          SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R12 immutable publication') WHERE OLD.status<>'published' OR NEW.status<>'withdrawn' OR NEW.publication_version<>OLD.publication_version+1 OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.gym_id IS NOT OLD.gym_id OR NEW.client_id IS NOT OLD.client_id OR NEW.link_id IS NOT OLD.link_id OR NEW.source_plan_id IS NOT OLD.source_plan_id OR NEW.schema_version IS NOT OLD.schema_version OR NEW.published_by IS NOT OLD.published_by OR NEW.published_at IS NOT OLD.published_at OR NEW.plan_json IS NOT OLD.plan_json OR NEW.plan_sha256 IS NOT OLD.plan_sha256 OR NEW.source_object_id IS NOT OLD.source_object_id OR NEW.object_key IS NOT OLD.object_key OR NEW.content_type IS NOT OLD.content_type OR NEW.byte_size IS NOT OLD.byte_size OR NEW.sha256 IS NOT OLD.sha256 OR NEW.storage_backend IS NOT OLD.storage_backend;
        END

checks.name: ck_client_link_labels
checks.sql: length(gym_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND length(client_display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

checks.name: ck_client_link_state
checks.sql: (status='pending' AND user_id IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR (status='active' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR (status='revoked' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND ((user_id IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: ck_client_invitation_state
checks.sql: (status='consumed' AND consumed_by IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at<expires_at AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR (status='pending' AND consumed_by IS NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL) OR (status='revoked' AND consumed_by IS NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_client_publication_pdf
checks.sql: (source_object_id IS NULL AND object_key IS NULL AND content_type IS NULL AND byte_size IS NULL AND sha256 IS NULL AND storage_backend IS NULL) OR (source_object_id IS NOT NULL AND length(source_object_id)=32 AND object_key IS NOT NULL AND length(object_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND content_type IS NOT NULL AND content_type='application/pdf' AND byte_size IS NOT NULL AND byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 67108864 AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND length(sha256)=64 AND storage_backend IS NOT NULL AND storage_backend IN ('local','s3'))

checks.name: ck_client_publication_state
checks.sql: (status='published' AND withdrawn_at IS NULL) OR (status='withdrawn' AND withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_cliente_sexo
checks.sql: sexo IN ('M', 'F', 'Otro') OR sexo IS NULL

checks.name: ck_generation_completed_publication
checks.sql: publication_protocol = 0 OR status <> 'completed' OR persisted_at IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_generation_publication_marker
checks.sql: persisted_at IS NULL OR (publication_protocol = 1 AND status = 'completed')

checks.name: ck_gym_generation_completed_result
checks.sql: status <> 'completed' OR result_json IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_mfa_authorization_binding
checks.sql: (purpose = 'login' AND access_hash IS NULL AND action_binding IS NULL AND ((consumed_at IS NULL AND factor_verified_at IS NULL) OR (consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND factor_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND factor_verified_at = consumed_at AND factor_verified_at >= created_at))) OR (purpose = 'reauth' AND access_hash IS NOT NULL AND length(access_hash) = 64 AND action_binding IS NULL AND factor_verified_at IS NULL) OR (purpose = 'action' AND access_hash IS NOT NULL AND length(access_hash) = 64 AND action_binding IS NOT NULL AND length(action_binding) = 64 AND factor_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND factor_verified_at <= created_at)

checks.name: ck_mfa_authorization_counters
checks.sql: session_version >= 0 AND generation >= 0 AND attempts >= 0 AND length(token_hash) = 64

checks.name: ck_mfa_credential_active
checks.sql: (secret_ciphertext IS NULL AND enabled_at IS NULL) OR (secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND enabled_at IS NOT NULL AND generation > 0)

checks.name: ck_mfa_credential_pending
checks.sql: (pending_id IS NULL AND pending_ciphertext IS NULL AND pending_expires_at IS NULL) OR (pending_id IS NOT NULL AND pending_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND pending_expires_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_usuario_reset_state
checks.sql: (password_reset_hash IS NULL AND password_reset_expires_at IS NULL AND password_reset_session_version IS NULL) OR (password_reset_hash IS NOT NULL AND length(password_reset_hash) = 64 AND password_reset_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND password_reset_session_version IS NOT NULL AND password_reset_session_version >= 0)
